audit_name: CPU CLI contract read-only audit round63
tests_reviewed: tests/test_oracle_study.py seed-boundary cases; image test coverage in attached image audit

findings.suggested_priority: P3, extreme explicit seed input validation
findings.trigger: Public --seed 18446744073709551615, accepted by torch.manual_seed itself, exceeds PyTorch range when a CLI derives seed+1.
findings.observed: All five PyTorch CLIs exit 1 with RuntimeError: Overflow when unpacking long. Their output directories have already been created and remain empty.
findings.primary_contract: Installed torch 2.6.0 torch.manual_seed docstring states inclusive [-0x8000_0000_0000_0000, 0xffff_ffff_ffff_ffff]; Generator.manual_seed(2**64-1).initial_seed() returned 18446744073709551615.
findings.impact: Extreme explicit seeds fail at stream construction; ordinary default seeds and small samples succeed. No existing artifacts were overwritten in the fresh-directory probes.
findings.suggested_resolution: Validate the base-seed range for every derived stream before creating output. Maximum offsets are experiment +5, image_flow +6, and all three solver/guidance CLIs +2. Document the supported base-seed interval and test public CLI rejection and safe boundaries.
findings.coverage_gap: Existing real CLI tests use ordinary seeds and test repeatability; no seed upper-bound tests in test_experiment.py or test_checkpoint.py.

findings.trigger: Public --frames 2 --fps 1e308 or --fps 1e-320. Both satisfy the advertised finite-positive FPS validation.
findings.observed: CLI exits 1 with ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant: inf after creating frames.npz and contact_sheet.png; metrics.json is absent. At 1e308 speed multiplication overflows. At 1e-320 timestamps/duration overflow, and persisted NPZ timestamps are [0.0, Infinity].
findings.impact: Unrealistic finite FPS values produce an incomplete run and, for the tiny FPS, an NPZ with a nonfinite timestamp. Default FPS and the smallest supported frame count succeed.
findings.suggested_resolution: Validate finite representability of derived timestamps/duration and speed before writing artifacts, producing a concise CLI error if the configured values cannot be represented.
findings.coverage_gap: Video tests cover units, doubling FPS, frame ordering, smallest frame count, and default CLI output, but no floating-point extremes.

successful_boundary_checks: Public flow experiment with one update, batch size 1, samples 1 completed and emitted checkpoint, JSON, NPZ, and plots; generated/reference/loss arrays finite.
Public DDPM experiment with one update, batch size 1, samples 1 completed with the same complete artifact set and finite arrays.
Public solver_study using the fresh flow checkpoint, samples 1, steps 1 and 2 completed; all saved initial/reference/baseline/endpoint arrays finite.
Public video_diagnostics with frames 2 and default FPS completed with contact sheet, NPZ and JSON.
All three image CLIs reject samples=8 with argparse exit 2 before creating output, consistently with their declared even samples>=16 constraint.
validation_scope: Fourteen controlled public CPU CLI invocations: four ordinary smallest-scale successful runs, five derived-seed overflows, two derived-FPS overflows, and three expected image sample-count rejections. Also directly verified the PyTorch maximum base-seed contract. Existing tests were reviewed; no full suite or trained image quality evaluation was run.

image_audit.audit: round63 image CLI contract read-only audit

findings.title: Accepted uint64 maximum seed overflows when derived RNG streams add offsets
findings.impact: All three image CLIs fail with an uncaught RuntimeError before producing results, while leaving a newly created empty output directory. This affects an edge of the accepted seed domain; default tutorial seeds are unaffected.
findings.trigger: --seed 18446744073709551615 with --samples 16 and one training/sampling step as applicable; solver/guidance load the temporary width=4 fixture specified in evidence.
findings.expected_contract: Either reject seeds outside the documented complete derived-stream range before creating output, or normalize and record every actual derived seed consistently.

existing_test_coverage.covers: Default seed 7; samples 16/32; checkpoint/metrics consistency; training RNG isolation from sampling budget.
Solver seed 123; 16 samples; frozen weights, paired initial arrays, diagnostics, checkpoint hash.
Training seed 7 and guidance seed 123; 16 samples; paired classes, scale array keys and metrics.

findings.coverage_gap: No seed-range or derived-seed-overflow cases found in the three image test modules.

other_review_results: All three CLIs explicitly require even samples >=16. Executed samples=8 controls exit 2 with argparse messages and leave output directories absent.

Read analytic Euler/guidance tests, image RNG isolation tests, checkpoint checks and metric counterexamples. No additional sample/layout/checkpoint-default-dtype contract fault found through the public CLI in this scope.
Image diagnostics use population standard deviations; paired image-guidance initial noise, labels and metric axes agree with their recorded definitions.
Existing nonempty-output guard was reviewed statically. Concurrent writers, filesystem failure paths and overwriting were not executed.
verification_limits: Untrained model with synthetic metadata used only to reach argument-dependent RNG initialization; no guidance quality or training result is asserted.
No extra training completed; uint64 seed image_flow fails before its training loop.
No complete pytest suite rerun; existing tests were read.
No trained-model quality, statistical convergence, GPU behavior, cross-platform reproducibility or in-process default-dtype overrides evaluated.
No tracked-file changes, Git writes, model downloads or network calls for external data.

overall: No high-priority issue found in the inspected ordinary reader paths. Confirmed findings concern extreme input validation and should be prioritized below learning-path gaps or normal-run faults.
